dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait. Fish don't count as meat?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Does fish count as meat? Hmm. I suppose each person might have a different answer in mind...

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: But that's not the problem here. I'm just wondering what I should have for dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, are you hungry? Would you like to have a little something?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: I don't mean to brag, but I do make some excellent food. Drop by if you've got the time and try some!
